product.title: Canyonlands National Park Half-Day Tour from Moab

description.text: On this half-day 4WD adventure from Moab, explore the rugged, red stone interior of Canyonlands National Park, where you'll experience the beauty of the Island in the Sky district and the stunning Gooseneck Overlook. Your professional guide will navigate your vehicle down the switchbacks of White Rim Road, where you will not only see the remains of ancient Pueblo civilizations, but also admire the canyon walls that drop 1,000 feet (300m) down. Stops include Potash Road, Utah Scenic Byway 279 Rock Art Sites, Island in the Sky, Musselman Arch, Shafer Trail Viewpoint, Canyonlands National Park. Transportation, safety gear, and local commentary are handled so you can focus on the red rock landscape. Ideal for travelers basing in Moab who want a guided Utah adventure without self-driving backcountry roads or river put-ins.
